title: 古爾法克斯油田
subcategoryTitle: 固定式平台與海上油田
subcategoryTitleEn: Fixed platforms and offshore oil fields
summary: 古爾法克斯是挪威海上油田群的代表；課程以多平台共同服務與海上能源供應的教學情境展開。本課依序分析多平台供電界面、海上結構支承、波浪循環的損傷帳、共享維修與共因事件、跨平台計量同步，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
summaryEn: Gullfaks represents Norwegian offshore developments; teaching scenarios examine shared multi-platform services and offshore energy supply. The course analyses multi-platform electrical interfaces, offshore structural support, wave-cycle damage account, shared maintenance and common causes, cross-platform meter synchronization, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 多平台供電界面、海上結構支承、波浪循環的損傷帳
v31FocusEn: Multi-platform electrical interfaces; Offshore structural support; Wave-cycle damage account

quiz.question: 關於「多平台供電界面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Multi-platform electrical interfaces" is correct?
options: 電力輸送損失可由電流平方乘電阻估算；在其他條件固定時，降低電流比單純縮短線路更能影響損失。
電流增加一成，電阻損失也只增加一成。
平均壓力低就代表平台基礎的所有極限狀態都合格。
optionsEn: Resistive electrical loss is current squared times resistance.
A ten-percent current rise increases resistive loss by only ten percent.
Low average pressure proves every foundation limit state passes.
quiz.explanation: 電力輸送損失可由電流平方乘電阻估算；在其他條件固定時，降低電流比單純縮短線路更能影響損失。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Resistive electrical loss is current squared times resistance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「多平台供電界面」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Multi-platform electrical interfaces” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Ploss = 3 I² R；代入 I = 250 A line current、R = 0.525 ohm per phase，得 98.4 kW（「多平台供電界面」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 I 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Ploss = 3 I² R; with I = 250 A line current, R = 0.525 ohm per phase the result is 98.4 kW (simplified exercise for Multi-platform electrical interfaces; every input is a teaching assumption, not measured, rated, design or operating data of this project.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise I by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：I 增加 10% 時，結果變為 119 kW（+21.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising I by 10% changes the result to 119 kW (+21.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 98.4 kW（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 I 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 98.4 kW (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in I with an engineering explanation.

steps.titleEn: Multi-platform electrical interfaces: testing and verification

steps.instruction: 針對「多平台供電界面」，建立帶有案例名稱與時間基準的證據表。先核對電流為線電流、電阻為每相值，再做三相損失估算；比較負載降低一成時的平方效應。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For “Multi-platform electrical interfaces”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis. Check that current is line current and resistance is per phase before calculating three-phase losses, then compare the squared effect of a ten-percent current reduction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Label the output 013-01 and mark charts “Gullfaks oil field: teaching assumptions”. State per-phase and three-phase definitions, losses and omissions; this simple relation cannot replace electrical protection design.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：「多平台供電界面」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An error at “Multi-platform electrical interfaces” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 多平台供電界面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Multi-platform electrical interfaces: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「多平台供電界面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Multi-platform electrical interfaces” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 「多平台供電界面」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。把三相總電阻再乘三會重複計數；只量一端電力而忽略時段差與輔助負載，也可能把設備用電誤算成線路損失。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「古爾法克斯油田」的安全、交付、壽命或環境。
steps.instructionEn: An error at “Multi-platform electrical interfaces” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. Multiplying an already three-phase total resistance by three double-counts loss; unsynchronized power readings and omitted auxiliary loads can also masquerade as line loss. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, delivery, life or environment of “Gullfaks oil field”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此處只處理等效電阻與固定負載的教學模型，無功、電壓調節、短路與保護協調不在範圍內。
